Node processes are running (DSH Web). The profile-inject module is imported at session-start time (each new agent session calls `buildProfileBlock`). Node caches ES modules **per-process** — so a currently-running DSH Web process that already imported the old module will keep the old code in memory until restarted. ## 一、诊断结论（硬数据）

查 `usage_audit.sqlite3`（11-13 02:06Z → 11-14 01:48Z）：
- **`caller=user` 主动检索 = 0 次**，同期会话消息写入 **924 次** → 主动查询率 ≈ 0%。
